home.title: Your studio notebook
home.trying: Trying Glazecalc as {name}. Start with a recipe.
home.welcomeBack: Pick up where you left off.

welcome.heading: Welcome to Glazecalc
welcome.text: Your notebook is ready. A good first step: type in a glaze you already mix, its materials and amounts, and see its unity formula.
welcome.confirm: Confirm your email: we sent a link to {email}. Two-step sign-in needs it. Your <account>account page</account> can send it again.
welcome.confirmText: We sent a link to {email}. Open it to confirm the address is yours: two-step sign-in needs it. Your <account>account page</account> can send it again.

recipe.title: Recipes
recipe.text: Build a glaze from materials and amounts, see its unity formula, and save it.

material.title: Materials
material.text: Add raw materials of your own, from a chemical formula or a supplier’s analysis.

additive.title: Additives and colorants
additive.text: Keep the colorants and opacifiers you add on top of a base glaze.

firing.title: Firing logs
firing.text: Record times, temperatures and cones for each firing.

notes.title: Notes
notes.text: Keep test results and anything else worth remembering.

advice.title: Glaze advice
advice.text: Tips on mixing, glazing and firing, and your own advice.

guides.title: Guides
guides.text: From what a glaze is to firing it, and keeping everyone safe on the way.

account.title: Account and settings
account.text: Settings, your password, two-step sign-in, and a download of everything you keep here.

home.newHere: New to unity formulas? The <advice>advice page</advice> explains the basics, and the <about>about page</about> says how Glazecalc works.

firing.title: Firing logs
firing.lead: Record each firing: times, temperatures, cones and kiln notes.
firing.addRow: Add a row to the firing table
firing.tableEmpty: Add a field above, then add rows.
firing.noneSaved: None yet. Saved firings appear here.
firing.fieldsMissing: Add at least one field to record, such as {example}.
firing.chooseField: Choose a field to add, then Add the field.
firing.fetchFailed: There was an error in getting the firing records information.
firing.saved: Success in adding the firing record to the server.
firing.saveFailed: Error: the request to the server failed.

notes.title: Notes
notes.lead: Anything else worth remembering about your glazes.

notes.fetchFailed: There was an error getting the notes information.
notes.saved: Success in adding the note to the server.
notes.saveFailed: Error: the request to the server failed.

trash.title: Trash
trash.comingSoon: The trash functionality is coming soon in the next version of Glazecalc. Until then, use the delete / remove with care: once it is gone the info is lost.
